# external/

Vendored third-party source, unmodified. Not part of this project's own
code; not distributed via pip.

- `brainglobe-atlasapi/` — clone of https://github.com/brainglobe/brainglobe-atlasapi,
  used for the BrainGlobe Atlas API (P15 DeMBA atlas). Gitignored — install
  it locally with `pip install -e external/brainglobe-atlasapi` (see the
  root [README.md](../README.md)). If a fix is needed, patch it upstream
  rather than editing the local clone.
